name: cache-meter
description: Band above the prompt: prompt-cache countdown, cache hit rate, context fill and a Compact button, plus a keepwarm row from cache-tax that pings the cache through breaks and stops a cold send once with its rewrite cost.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after a request: 5m on the default tier, 1h where the session uses the one-hour cache.
